**Prism Ray** is the first Prism edition: prompts for Claude models only, written by Gemini on Vertex AI. It installs next to Prism Spectrum as a separate app. You need a Vertex AI API key and a Google Cloud project ID (Settings).

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `Prism-Ray-Setup-<version>-x64.exe` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `Prism-Ray-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Prism-Ray-<version>-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Linux (x64) | `Prism-Ray-<version>-linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The builds aren't signed with a paid certificate, so the first launch needs one confirmation. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. More: https://ugurshelby.github.io/prism/download/
